comment: No source is published; the maker's page is at kilpatrickaudio.com/?p=virtue-vcv. The module declares 33 parameters: the sixteen buttons, and seventeen more with no name, no widget and no census position, which are the per-button latch flags and the backlight. None of those seventeen can be clicked, so none gets a line. The L and M keys are handled in the button's hover-key handler, keys 76 and 77.
